Well, I came in because... I keep hearing people talking about me. It happens a lot at work. I'll hear them through the conference room walls, or even from my cell phone when it's completely turned off. 

It's usually the board members or my staff, and they're... they're saying I'm ruining the company. The thing is, it sounds so incredibly clear. It's so real that I actually answer them back out loud, right there, before I even realize that no one else around me heard a thing.
